_comment: One exercise per lesson of the learning path's first stage (Start here), for the
playground's lesson bar: a task in a sentence or two, a hint, and how the playground
decides the task is done. Editorial, like learning-path.json beside it - which is why
it is not in catalogue.json, whose shape is a published contract (check-catalogue-
contract.mjs). The playground reads this file from the commit it pins.
A check is the conjunction of:
view        patterns the view XML must match (the XML the abap2UI5 linter rebuilds
from the builder chain - what the playground's View tab shows),
source      patterns the ABAP of the open files must match,
sourceNot   patterns it must no longer match,
tests       the least number of unit tests that ran in the last Run, all passing.
Every pattern is a JavaScript regular expression, matched case-insensitively.
A view pattern sees only what the linter can rebuild: an attribute set from a
variable (t = greet, a text symbol read into it) is not in that XML, and an event
is written without its name (press=".eB()"), so a task about either is checked
on the source.
scripts/check-exercises.mjs holds this file to: one exercise per Start-here class and
none for any other, every pattern compiles, and the sample as committed does NOT
already pass its source checks - an exercise that is solved before it starts teaches
nothing.

z2ui5_cl_smp_app_493.task: Greet yourself: make the Title say Hello and your name instead of Hello World, and add a Text under it that says what you are learning.
z2ui5_cl_smp_app_493.hint: The title is the page->tag( `Title` ) call. A Text is one more page->tag( `Text` )->a( n = `text` v = `...` ) below it.

z2ui5_cl_smp_app_494.task: Change what Greet writes back: make it say Good morning and the name, then Run and press Greet.
z2ui5_cl_smp_app_494.hint: GREETING is set in the GREET branch of main( ) - one string template.

z2ui5_cl_smp_app_495.task: Add a third button, Clear, with an event of its own that empties the list of calls.
z2ui5_cl_smp_app_495.hint: A button with press = client->_event( `CLEAR` ) in the HBox, and in main( ) an ELSEIF client->check_on_event( `CLEAR` ) that does CLEAR t_log.

z2ui5_cl_smp_app_004.task: Add a fifth button to the main view that shows a message toast: an event BUTTON_HELLO, and a WHEN branch for it in on_event( ).
z2ui5_cl_smp_app_004.hint: Copy one of the Button blocks with its press = client->_event( `...` ), and in on_event( ) add WHEN `BUTTON_HELLO`. client->message_toast_display( `...` ).

z2ui5_cl_smp_app_496.task: Add a second Input to the form, bound to a new public attribute. Run, type into it, press Send, and find what you typed under Previous Request (Ctrl+F12).
z2ui5_cl_smp_app_496.hint: DATA comment TYPE string. in the PUBLIC SECTION, then a Label and an Input with value = client->_bind( comment ) in the form's content.

z2ui5_cl_smp_app_503.task: Add a fifth test to the test class: 200 net at 10 percent is 220 gross. Run - the Tests tab has to show five tests, all green.
z2ui5_cl_smp_app_503.hint: One more METHODS ... FOR TESTING in the definition, and an implementation with cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 220 act = cut->gross_amount( net = 200 percent = 10 ) ).

z2ui5_cl_smp_app_519.task: Give the Greet button a tooltip that is a text symbol of its own, 004, the way the other three are.
z2ui5_cl_smp_app_519.hint: Read 'Say hello'(004) into a variable like greet, and add )->a( n = `tooltip` t = <variable> to the Button.
